name: chatbotarena.se
description: chatbotarena.se is a human benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of large language models in understanding and generating Swedish language texts using forced choice ranking, aiming to improve understanding of LLM performance in low-resource languages.
reputation: A new, niche benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly of interest to researchers studying Swedish and other low-resource language evaluation.
notes: Modified version of ChatbotArena benchmark; focuses on Swedish language; aims to create a leaderboard.
